name: handwave
description: Browse and preview Handwave articles linked to Lean declarations.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Source browsing remains available, but Handwave does not execute Lake or Lean until the workspace is trusted.

editor/title.when: editorLangId == handwave-article || editorLangId == lean || editorLangId == lean4 || resourceExtname == .hw || resourceExtname == .lean || resourceFilename =~ /\.hw\.md$/

handwave.articleGlobs.description: Glob patterns for Handwave article files.

handwave.leanGlobs.description: Glob patterns for Lean files indexed by Handwave.

handwave.excludeGlob.description: Glob pattern excluded when Handwave indexes articles and Lean files.

handwave.enableDiagnostics.description: Enable diagnostics for unresolved Handwave links, includes, and malformed doc blocks.

handwave.enableLeanDependencyChecks.description: Use Lean build artifacts to decide whether theorem dependencies transitively depend on sorryAx. When disabled, Handwave performs source-only checks and does not launch Lean in the background.

handwave.leanDependencyCheckBackend.description: Backend for Lean dependency checks. 'subprocess' builds/reads Lean artifacts with one cached lake env lean extractor and never opens hidden Lean documents; 'leanServer' asks the running Lean language server for #print axioms diagnostics.

handwave.leanDependencyCheckDelayMs.description: Delay before running queued Lean dependency checks.

handwave.autoBuildLeanArtifacts.description: Automatically ask Lake to build the required .olean and .ilean artifacts before an on-demand Handwave extraction. Disabled in untrusted workspaces.

handwave.leanArtifactBuildTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for an automatic targeted Lake artifact build.

handwave.leanDependencyCheckTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for each Handwave Lean dependency-check probe.

handwave.leanDependencyCheckBatchSize.description: Maximum number of compatible declarations to extract in one Handwave Lean process.
